sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r15/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 49 = check 48; Internal Quality Checks row 49, no extra annotation)
.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r15/rules/projects/webdev-task-template/tests/app_context.md and the five template prompt.md files (diffed against the task)
task/tests/gates/render/judge.toml, gates/constraints/judge.toml, scored/functional/judge.toml (all 43 criteria), scored/polish/judge.toml, scored/visual/judge.toml
evidence: All five prompts and the injected app_context describe this app and agree with each other, the criteria and the public notes; no sibling-task residue found. (1) Product/URL: each prompt opens 'Evaluate the live Colderwater playground at http://localhost:3000' (render/constraints/functional/polish/visual prompt.md:1) and app_context.md:3-4 gives 'Name: Colderwater playground / URL: http://localhost:3000'; integration.md:3 'Listen on port 3000'. Case-insensitive grep of task md/toml/json/sh/py for coldwater (misspelling), hireops, password, login, admin, TODO, FIXME, CHANGE_ME returned nothing; the template's CHANGE_ME fields and its sign-in wording ('reachability and sign-in gate', 'accounts under Accounts can sign in', 'forged request') were all replaced. (2) Accounts: app_context.md:10 'None. The app has no sign-in; every browser tab or context uses the same shared library' matches instruction.md:5 'without signing in' and policy.md:3 'without sign-in or private accounts'; no prompt mentions an account. (3) Screens: app_context.md:14 'One workspace at /' with title and filename fields, editor with Undo, Redo, Format, Find and Replace, line and column readout, Run, Stop, New, Save, preview, console, library, history - every item is asked for in ui.md:5,9,11,15,17 and integration.md:3 'serve the workspace at /'. (4) Entities: 'shared library of saved snippets with revision history. The filename ending (.js or .html) chooses how Run executes' (app_context.md:6) matches overview.md:3. (5) Cross-references resolve: constraints prompt.md:5 'the browser-storage clearing that the second criterion asks for' - the second criterion is cw_shared_saved_record, which says 'clear this origin's browser storage as described in the application notes'; functional prompt.md:22 'the three uses named in the application notes' matches app_context.md:27 'exactly three things' (storage clearing, replay, one localStorage entry), used by cw_save_reload_restart, cw_restore_request_repeat_safe and cw_preview_isolation respectively; functional prompt.md:33 'the `restart_app` tool of the `verifier` MCP server' matches functional/judge.toml:15 name = "verifier" and restart_mcp.py TOOL name 'restart_app', and exactly one criterion (cw_save_reload_restart) names it, as prompt.md:7 says; render, constraints, polish and visual prompts say 'Never restart the app' and their judge.toml files have no verifier server; app_context.md:25 'Health address: http://localhost:3000/api/health. One criterion also uses a public https address of your choice' matches integration.md:3 and cw_preview_isolation only. (6) The global browser gate text in functional/polish/visual prompt.md:5 ('text typed into the code editor appears in it') is the same bar as the render criterion cw_workspace_loads_and_takes_typing. (7) Visual prompt.md:9 '0 is used only when the thing being judged is not shown at all' agrees with every 0 anchor in visual/judge.toml ('no editor is shown', 'no workspace is shown', 'no app surface is shown'); its caret and double-click selection set-up (line 14) matches cw_visual_editor_readability. (8) Polish prompt.md:1 scope 'keyboard access, focus, feedback and narrow screens' covers its six criteria, none of which needs script or a restart, consistent with prompt.md:7,19. All 43 functional and 6 polish criteria contain a 'Fails if' clause as the prompts state. Notes, none a defect: (a) the name 'Colderwater' appears only in grader files, task.toml and the solution, never in instruction.md or the six notes, but no prompt or criterion requires the app to display it, so a conforming app titled differently loses nothing; (b) 'each ends with the conditions under which it fails' is loosely worded - several criteria put one clarifying sentence after the Fails clause (e.g. cw_block_indent_undo, cw_narrow_width_usable), and the render prompt's 'move on to the next criterion' is boilerplate for a one-criterion gate; (c) functional prompt.md:18 asks the judge to quote 'revision numbers' while the notes speak only of 'revisions' - it is a reporting hint, not a pass condition in the prompt. Evidence index: all 16 scripted-golden artifacts and 2 of the 6 hosted-run artifacts match their recorded SHA256; the other 4 (run-4e686738 result.json, reward.json and the two reward-details.json) differ only by CRLF line endings in the worktree checkout (core.autocrlf=true) and match once normalised to LF. No configured judge run exists for these bytes, so how the judge actually reads these prompts is not measured; this row is a static accuracy check and does not depend on that measurement.
